2609.17965.title: Measuring AI Leadership: Development and Validation of a Multidimensional Measure for AI-Native Organizations
2609.17965.paper_summary: AI is changing what leaders must judge, explain, learn, and coordinate, yet existing measures do not capture these behaviors at the level needed to study leadership in AI-enabled work. We develop the AI Leadership Battery, which organizes 36 behaviorally specific subdimensions into 11 theory-specified content families. Following established scale-development procedures, the research used deductive item generation; content validation of definitional correspondence and definitional distinctiveness; exploratory factor analysis and item reduction; confirmatory factor analysis in independent samples; and tests of internal consistency reliability, convergent validity, discriminant validity, and criterion-related and incremental validity. Across the development and validation studies, the analyses provided evidence for the Battery's content, multidimensional structure, reliability, and distinction from selected orbiting constructs. The Battery also contributed additional information beyond orbiting constructs across organizational growth, decision speed, customer/stakeholder response capability, AI-enabled team performance, AI-enabled work experience, AI security and risk management, and AI adoption and integration. The resulting measure provides researchers with a behavioral framework for examining how leaders in AI-enabled work regulate judgment, learning, adaptation, transparency, and accountability.
2609.17965.paper_summary_zh: AI 正在改變領導者必須判斷、解釋、學習和協調的內容，但現有的衡量標準並未捕捉到這些行為，無法在研究 AI 驅動的工作中的領導力時達到所需的水平。我們開發了 AI 領導力電池，它將 36 個行為特定的子維度組織成 11 個理論指定的內容家族。根據既定的量表開發程序，研究使用了演繹性項目生成；對定義對應性和定義區別性的內容驗證；探索性因素分析和項目縮減；在獨立樣本中的驗證性因素分析；以及內部一致性可靠性、收斂效度、區別效度和標準相關及增量效度的測試。在開發和驗證研究中，分析提供了對電池內容、多維結構、可靠性以及與選定的相關構念之間的區別的證據。該電池還提供了超越相關構念的額外信息，涵蓋組織增長、決策速度、客戶/利益相關者反應能力、AI 驅動的團隊表現、AI 驅動的工作經驗、AI 安全和風險管理，以及 AI 採用和整合。最終的測量為研究人員提供了一個行為框架，以檢視 AI 驅動工作中的領導者如何調節判斷、學習、適應、透明度和問責制。
2609.17965.author: Mustafa Akben et.al.
